environment.description: EKS 1.28 cluster, pod running in namespace 'platform-services' with default restart policy (Always). Pod has IRSA role arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/config-service-role with ssm:GetParameter, ssm:DeleteParameter, ssm:PutParameter permissions. No permission boundary on the role. Pod security context allows CGO with no seccomp profile. gRPC endpoint exposed via internal NLB with no rate limiting. Kubernetes liveness probe configured with failureThreshold: 10, periodSeconds: 30 (5 minute tolerance). An attacker with internal network access can repeatedly crash the pod by requesting non-existent config keys, causing null pointer dereference and SIGSEGV. During crash loops, the DeleteConfig path's ssm:DeleteParameter calls succeed, allowing data destruction.
